text: Many students live in a Studentenwohnheim (hall of residence) or in a WG (Wohngemeinschaft), a flat share where each person has a room and everybody shares the kitchen and bathroom. In Berlin, many halls of residence are run by the Studierendenwerk, the student services organisation.
Finding a room in a WG often means a WG-Casting: a short, friendly interview with the current flatmates, who want to know if you will fit in.
